# Before You Book That Surgery
> The patient's side of the table. Free, private tools that help people considering cosmetic surgery see what can be checked, what still needs asking, and what they want, before any deposit. Paid for by patients, never by surgeons. US-focused.

Founder: Jasmine Louis Marrero, 20 years inside the aesthetics industry, now working independently for patients. Contact: justask@beforeyoubookthatsurgery.com

## Tools
- [The Light Map](https://beforeyoubookthatsurgery.com/light-map): check a surgeon and clinic across nine public-record areas (license, board certification, hospital privileges, facility accreditation, anesthesia, court records). Result: Advance, Hold or Halt, plus a one-page consult sheet.
- [My Path](https://beforeyoubookthatsurgery.com/path): from your why, to the questions to answer before a deposit, to permission to decide, surgery day, recovery and clearance.
- [How to use](https://beforeyoubookthatsurgery.com/how-to-use): guides for the patient and for the companion.
- [Independence and privacy](https://beforeyoubookthatsurgery.com/privacy): no referral fees, affiliate links, sponsorships or free procedures. Answers stay on the user's device.

## The three questions consults most often leave unanswered
1. Credentials: Which board certified you, and which hospital gives you privileges to do this exact procedure?
2. Anesthesia: Who gives my anesthesia, what is their license, and are they in the room the entire time?
3. If it goes wrong: Which hospital would I go to, what does a revision cost me, and do you carry malpractice coverage?

## Scope
Informational only. Does not diagnose, assess candidacy, or recommend procedures, surgeons or clinics. In an emergency, call 911.
